name: @loro/promo
description: The landing page's motion video, made in code: Remotion scenes, a synthesized score and effects, and a voiceover in the app's voices.

scripts.audio: pnpm assets && pnpm voice && pnpm timeline && pnpm synth
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts LoroPromo out/loro-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-bitrate 192k
scripts.render:webm: remotion render src/index.ts LoroPromo out/loro-promo.webm --codec vp9 --crf 30
scripts.render:poster: remotion still src/index.ts LoroPromo out/loro-promo-poster.jpg --frame 2310 --image-format jpeg
scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/loro-promo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 24 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 160k out/loro-promo-web.mp4
scripts.video: pnpm audio && pnpm render && pnpm web && pnpm render:poster
